reject_access_expired: Your access to this host has expired — ask the host's owner to grant it again.
reject_approval_timeout: Nobody approved the request on the host in time — approve this device in the host's console or web UI, then request access again.
reject_bound_other: The host's pairing window is armed for a different device — arm it for this one.
reject_busy: The host is busy with another session.
reject_denied: The host declined this device's request.
reject_host_power: The host is going to sleep or shutting down — wake it when you want to play again.
reject_identity_required: The host requires pairing — pair this device (PIN or request access) first.
reject_launch_not_permitted: This device isn't permitted to launch games on the host — connect without picking a game, or ask the host's owner to allow launching.
reject_not_armed: Pairing isn't armed on the host — arm it on the host's Pairing page, then try again.
reject_profile_locked: This profile is locked. Enter its password.
reject_profile_unknown: That profile is gone from this host. Pick another one.
reject_rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts — wait a couple of seconds and try again.
reject_seat_occupied: Someone is already playing as that profile.
reject_seat_unavailable: That profile can't play on this host right now.
reject_setup_failed: The host accepted the connection but couldn't start the stream — the host's log (web console → Log) has the cause.
reject_superseded: A newer request from this device replaced this one — approve the latest request on the host.
reject_wire_version: Client and host versions don't match — update both to the same release.
